t: This is The White House, a hotel in London that was formerly serviced flats. It was designed by Robert Atkinson, an English architect who worked mainly in the Art Deco style. So as you look at the building, you're looking at the work of someone known for that look. Atkinson lived from 1883 to 1952, and his name is the main thread connecting the building to its story. There's little more I can say with certainty, so take a moment to notice the facade and the details of the design.
